questions.stem: Per this page, when is `StringBuffer` the right choice over `StringBuilder`?

options.text: When the text will grow past sixteen characters
options.says: Both classes grow as needed; the page ties the choice to thread safety, not length.

options.text: When the result must end up as a String value
options.says: Both classes turn into a String with toString(); that does not decide between them.

options.text: When several threads modify the same object at once
options.says: The page says StringBuffer is synchronized, for multi-threaded code that modifies the same buffer.

questions.stem: Per this page, what happens with `sb.append(null)`, written with a bare `null` literal?

options.text: The call is rejected, since it fits several overloads
options.says: The page says the bare literal call is ambiguous among append's overloads, so it does not compile.

options.text: The call runs, and the builder gains the text "null"
options.says: The page says that happens for a typed null variable; the bare literal does not compile.

options.text: The call throws NullPointerException when it runs
options.says: The page says the bare literal call is ambiguous and does not compile, so nothing runs.
